definitions.explanation: Lacking distinction or special qualities. Describes something or someone that is average and does not stand out. Can be neutral or carry a slightly negative nuance depending on context.

examples.japanese: {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To lead an ordinary daily life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平凡|へいぼん}だった。

{平凡|へいぼん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧みれば⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧や⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{隠|かく}されている→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
examples.english: Even in this town that looks ordinary, if you look, you can find interesting history and culture hidden away.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{平|へい} (flat, ordinary) + {凡|ぼん} (common, mediocre).

FORMS:
- Predicate: {平凡|へいぼん}だ / {平凡|へいぼん}です
- Modifier: {平凡|へいぼん}な + noun
- Adverb: {平凡|へいぼん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

USAGE:
{平凡|へいぼん} can be neutral (simply meaning ordinary) or slightly negative (implying dull or mediocre), depending on context. When describing one's own life, it can carry a modest or even positive tone — the idea that a {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ (ordinary happiness) is something to appreciate. The antonym is ⟦{非凡|ひぼん}→非凡：15600_hibon⟧ (extraordinary, exceptional).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧: an ordinary life
- {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: ordinary daily life
- {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: ordinary living
- {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ: ordinary happiness
